exposure: Multidisciplinary Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS) program with maternal fetal medicine specialist as primary surgeon
Pre-Program cohort (no MFM specialist as primary surgeon)
cohort: Women who received a peripartum hysterectomy at delivery with confirmed pathologic diagnosis for Placenta Accreta Spectrum (PAS).
finding: A multidisciplinary PAS program utilizing MFM specialists as primary surgeons significantly decreased packed red blood cell utilization, estimated blood loss, ICU admission, urologic consultations, postoperative ileus, and postoperative length of stay compared to a pre-program cohort.
